text: Partners' own field-service software can't click through a portal -- it needs a real, callable API.
Dmitri builds a Scripted REST API: GET /api/x_brind_claims/claims, filtered by a partner_company parameter.
The handler is plain GlideRecord -- addQuery, query, loop -- building the JSON response from whatever matches.
Authenticated as Driscoll Mechanical Services, passing Driscoll's own partner_company value, their own claims come back correctly.
Next: a full dress rehearsal of the whole partner workflow, start to finish.
